heuristics.statement: For the fixed complete BLAKE3-r3 and f_S(x)=F(LE32(S)||LE32(x)), independent uniform full-width salt and start have positive orbit tail, cycle length at least2^116, and tail-plus-cycle length at most2^128 with probability at least0.39.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the salted64-byte full256-bit state injection and single bounded sparse-checkpoint attempt.
heuristics.extrapolation: Transfer the explicit finite random-mapping orbit bound and organizer-produced12/16-bit projection evidence to the fixed full-width target, including the sparse-gap cycle-length condition.
heuristics.limitations: No full-width evidence or independence proof. Finite projected mask collisions are not full collisions. Dense probes use spacing1; sparse probes use ratio1/16 rather than full-width1/4096. Full-width extrapolation and narrow success margin remain material.
